sections.verified:
- The Common Cartridge contains real QTI quiz data, not only rendered course pages.
- The archive has enough information to recreate quiz titles, item types, prompts, choices, many answer keys, and embedded images.
- The current Google Forms bridge direction is compatible with this data: QTI can provide answer controls while QTI HTML/assets can provide prompt images.
- A QTI visual-prompt path is likely safer than the PDF crop path because each question is already separated into an item with referenced assets.
sections.weakProvisional:
- I did not implement or run a converter for this cartridge yet.
- I did not inspect every QTI item individually.
- Some image assets are diagrams inside a text question, while others are handwritten/full-question-style images, so rendering needs to handle both cases.
sections.unverified:
- Exact Google Forms output quality for a live Math 10C cartridge-derived quiz.
- How many QTI HTML math expressions render cleanly without converting the whole item to an image.
- Whether quiz settings such as timing, attempts, randomization, and section behavior should be preserved.
sections.risks:
- Google Forms may not support all D2L quiz settings or grading behaviors.
- Multiple-response and fill-in-the-blank items need careful mapping to Google checkbox/short-answer behavior.
- Essay/written-response items have no automatic answer key in the QTI scoring data.
